label: Static
prompt: Locked-off tripod shot, zero camera movement: the framing, zoom and focus stay exactly as in the first frame for the whole clip, no push-in, no reframing, no refocus. The background stays still and sharp; only the subject and small ambient details move, gently and naturally.
phrase: the camera holds still on a locked-off tripod
notes: 18 Oct (Lumi rough cut): the old prompt asked for a 'medium close-up, 50mm', and LTX-2.5 read that as a push-in from a wider start frame (the Cold open drifted in and refocused, so the background pumped and smeared around her head). This prompt names no framing and pins the first frame instead.
